Whether you're commuting through Portland, taking the family to the Oregon coast, or loading up for a weekend getaway, this 2024 Honda CR-V delivers the comfort, efficiency, versatility, and dependable Honda quality you're looking for.

This 2024 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid LE delivers an efficient and capable driving experience with a practical design built for real-world ownership.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- 41 city MPG and 38 highway MPG with AWD
- All-weather floor liners and cargo tray

- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Rear window defroster
- 17-inch silver aluminum alloy wheels
- Rear backup camera
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6 speakers
- Speed-sensing power steering

The 2.5L 4-cylinder hybrid engine paired with all-wheel drive offers dependable performance while the eCVT transmission provides smooth power delivery. You'll appreciate the responsive handling from the four-wheel independent suspension and the confidence that comes with electronic stability control and speed-sensing steering.

The cabin combines comfort and convenience with front bucket seats featuring a center armrest, dual-zone climate control, and a tilt and telescoping steering wheel to find your ideal driving position. Built-in protection comes standard with this model. The applied paint protection film safeguards your hood, fenders, door cups, and mirror backs from road debris and weathering. Additional protection features include body side molding and mudguards to shield your vehicle's exterior, plus all-weather floor liners and a cargo tray to protect interior surfaces from moisture and spills.

Safety is integrated throughout with dual front impact airbags, dual front side airbags, a knee airbag, and an overhead airbag system. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, low tire pressure warning, and Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication system (one-year trial included) provide additional peace of mind.

This RAV4 Hybrid LE represents the practical choice for drivers seeking reliability, efficiency, and thoughtful design in a versatile package. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the balanced capabilities this vehicle offers for your daily needs.

The legendary HEMI 5.7L V8 engine provides the capability and character that Charger drivers demand, while the 8-Speed Automatic transmission ensures smooth, responsive shifting. Safety systems throughout include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and traction control. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and an occupant sensing system provide comprehensive protection.

This R/T combines unmistakable performance heritage with a thoughtful selection of modern conveniences. We invite you to experience this Charger firsthand and see how it meets your driving needs.

This 2021 Honda Pilot EX-L represents a sophisticated three-row SUV designed to meet the demands of families and individuals who prioritize versatility, safety, and comfort in their daily driving.

- Automatic Headlights
- Backup Camera
- Blind Spot Monitor
- Bluetooth
- Collision Avoidance
- Collision Warning System
- Drowsiness Alert
- Keyless Access with Pushbutton Start
- Smartphone Integration
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Leather Seat Trim
- Panoramic Power Moonroof
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- 18 Machine-Finished Alloy Wheels
- 215-Watt Audio System with SiriusXM

The EX-L trim delivers thoughtful standard equipment that emphasizes both driver awareness and passenger convenience. Leather seating surfaces wrap heated front bucket seats, while the automatic climate control system manages three separate zones for optimal comfort throughout the cabin. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds practical daily functionality.

Under the hood, this Pilot is powered by a 3.5L V6 engine paired with an automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, providing balanced fuel efficiency with an estimated 19 MPG city and 26 MPG highway. The suspension system is engineered with four-wheel independent components and speed-sensing steering, creating a composed driving experience whether navigating city streets or highway conditions.

Safety technology integrates seamlessly into the driving experience through the Lane Keeping Assist System, Collision Mitigation Braking System with Forward Collision Warning, and the Blind Spot Information System. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror, rear window wiper with speed-sensitive operation, and front fog lights enhance visibility in varying weather conditions. Emergency communication through HondaLink Assist provides additional peace of mind.

The three-row seating configuration offers flexible passenger accommodation, with the third row featuring split-bench seating and recline capability for extended journeys. The power liftgate simplifies loading, while the split-folding rear seat creates practical cargo arrangements to match your lifestyle needs.

With 72,948 miles on the odometer, this 2021 Pilot EX-L has been responsibly maintained and remains well-positioned to provide years of capable service. Contact our dealership today to schedule a comprehensive test drive and discover how this vehicle can enhance your driving experience.

Introducing the 2027 INFINITI QX80 LUXE, a three-row luxury SUV designed for discerning drivers who demand both sophistication and capability in their daily pursuits.

- 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission
- Klipsch Premium Audio System with 14 Speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Google Built-in Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heads-Up Display for enhanced driving awareness
- Climate Controlled Front Bucket Seats with heating and ventilation
- Heated rear seats and heated steering wheel for year-round comfort
- Power moonroof for an open-air experience
- 22" Aluminum Alloy wheels
- Adaptive suspension and four-wheel independent suspension
- Active Cruise Control with Electronic Stability Control
- Exterior Parking Camera with rear visibility
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off functionality
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee and overhead airbags
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory settings
- Split folding rear seat and reclining third-row bench seating

This White exterior commands presence on the road while maintaining the refined aesthetic INFINITI is known for. The LUXE trim delivers comprehensive comfort features including dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning, ensuring every passenger enjoys their journey. Memory functions for both the driver's seat and steering wheel personalize your experience, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror and illuminated entry add touches of convenience.

The QX80's interior prioritizes both luxury and practicality. Ventilated front seats work alongside heated options to maintain ideal comfort regardless of season, while the power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading. The navigation system integrates Google Built-in technology seamlessly, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention where it belongs.

Safety systems throughout this vehicle provide comprehensive protection for occupants. Adaptive suspension adapts to varying road conditions, while the traction control and anti-roll bars contribute to confident handling. The comprehensive airbag system, combined with ABS brakes and electronic stability control, creates multiple layers of occupant security.

With an EPA estimated 16 city and 20 highway MPG, the twin-turbocharged V6 balances performance with reasonable fuel economy. The vehicle arrives with a full tank of fuel and floor mats, ready for immediate enjoyment.

This 2027 QX80 LUXE represents an opportunity to own a luxury three-row SUV that seamlessly blends technology, comfort, and reliability. This 2024 GMC Yukon Denali in Silver delivers the commanding presence and refined capability you expect from a premium full-size SUV.

- Dual-Pane Power Panoramic Sunroof with express-open and express-close
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- Perforated Heated and Ventilated Driver and Front Passenger Seats
- 3rd Row 60/40 Power-Folding Split-Bench Seat for flexible interior configuration
- Bose 14-Speaker Surround Sound System with CenterPoint technology
- 15 Diagonal Multi-Color Head-Up Display
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Following Distance Indicator
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Hands-Free Power Programmable Rear Liftgate
- HD Surround Vision with Front and Rear Park Assist
- Wireless Charging for mobile devices
- Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian Braking
- Heated Steering Wheel with power tilt and telescopic adjustment
- 12-Way Power Seat Adjusters with memory settings
- Outside Heated Power-Adjustable Mirrors with memory presets

The Yukon Denali seats up to eight with thoughtfully arranged seating across three rows. The driver benefits from a heated and ventilated perforated leather seat with 12-way power adjustment and memory functions, while the second row offers heated outboard positions in the bucket configuration. Heated second-row seating ensures comfort for all passengers during colder months, and the power-folding third-row bench seat provides convenient access and flexible cargo space when needed.

Technology and safety features work seamlessly throughout this vehicle. The 15-inch Head-Up Display presents critical driving information directly in your line of sight, while the Bose surround sound system elevates every drive with premium audio quality. Safety technologies including Lane Keep Assist, Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking provide multiple layers of protection for you and your passengers.

The exterior reflects the Denali's upscale positioning with chrome door handles featuring body-color strips, bright front and rear door sill plates, and galvano bodyside moldings. The dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light while the power sunshade offers control over glare and heat. Twenty-inch polished aluminum wheels and a dual exhaust system complete the refined appearance.

Inside, the heated steering wheel adjusts via power tilt and telescopic mechanism to find your ideal position, while the auto-dimming inside rear-view mirror and 2 presets for outside rearview mirrors add practical convenience. The universal home remote lets you manage your garage doors from the vehicle, and the wireless charging pad keeps your devices powered throughout the day.

The sales price includes all applicable rebates and incentives, making this an opportunity to own a well-equipped Denali. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Yukon Denali's spacious interior, commanding driving position, and the comprehensive technology suite that defines this premium SUV.

Discover the 2023 Toyota Highlander XLE, a three-row SUV designed to serve your family's needs with capability and comfort. This Silver beauty combines practical space with modern convenience features to keep everyone connected and comfortable on every journey.

- 12.3 Toyota Audio Multimedia with 6 speakers
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 3-month platinum trial
- Power moonroof
- Heated front bucket seats
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Rear air conditioning
- Power driver and passenger seats
- Exterior parking camera rear
- Electronic stability control with traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Roof rack rails
- 18 machined-finish alloy wheels
- Split folding rear seat with 3rd row split-bench seating

The Highlander XLE seats up to eight passengers across three rows, making it an excellent choice for larger families or those who frequently transport groups. The second and third rows provide flexibility fold them down when you need cargo space, or keep them raised for passenger comfort during road trips.

Under the hood, the 2.4L turbocharged four-cylinder engine delivers 265 horsepower while achieving 22 MPG in the city and 29 MPG on the highway. The eight-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive provide smooth, responsive performance for daily driving, highway cruising, and everything in between.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin with SofTex seat trim, heated front seats, and power adjustments for both driver and passenger. The 12.3 touchscreen audio system keeps you entertained with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth streaming, and SiriusXM satellite radio. Multiple USB charge ports ensure your devices stay powered during commutes and long drives.

Safety features include multiple airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and a rear-view camera to assist with parking and reversing. Toyota Safety Connect provides emergency communication capabilities, offering additional peace of mind for you and your passengers.

The XLE trim strikes a balanced approach between value and features, delivering the practical three-row versatility Toyota SUVs are known for. With its silver exterior, modern technology suite, and proven Toyota reliability, this Highlander is ready to meet your family's adventures. Visit our showroom to experience the comfort and capability firsthand.

The flexible seating configuration adapts to your lifestyle. The third row seat provides additional passenger capacity when needed, while the split-folding rear seat allows you to reconfigure interior space for cargo when necessary. Premium MB-Tex seat trim adds a touch of quality to the driving environment.

At 18,964 miles, this 2025 model is essentially new and ready to serve you for years to come. With a comprehensive suite of driver assistance features, comfortable accommodations for up to seven passengers, and intuitive technology, the GLE 350 4MATIC® is prepared to meet the demands of today's driver. We invite you to experience this Mercedes-Benz SUV firsthand at our showroom.

The innovative HD Surround Vision and Bed View Camera provide complete visibility around the vehicle.

For those who tow, this Sierra is fully equipped. The Integrated Trailering System with Hitch Guidance and Integrated Trailer Brake Controller makes hitching and maneuvering simple. Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert and Trailer Camera Provisions add confidence to every towing situation.

This 2025 Sierra 1500 Denali represents the pinnacle of truck capability, combining genuine luxury appointments with the strength and confidence you expect from GMC. Visit us to experience this exceptional truck firsthand and take the next step toward ownership.
